name: FlightSegment
description: A single flight segment (one physical flight): times, IATA codes, cities, duration, stops and optional aircraft. Appears in results, booking summary, Manage Booking and check-in.

provenance.tag: Structure: A · unverified; 24px times: A · unverified; RTL and accessibility: Rec

props.name: arrival
props.description: dayOffset shows "+1" next to the arrival time.

props.name: density
props.description: compact for the booking summary and mobile.

requirements: The visual layout is not a sentence: render one visually hidden summary ("Departs Dubai DXB 08:40. Arrives London Heathrow LHR 13:55, next day. 7 hours 15 minutes. Direct. Airbus A380.") and mark the visual pieces aria-hidden.
Durations are written out for screen readers ("7 hours 15 minutes", not "7h 15m").

responsive.behavior: density="compact" in the booking summary (including the ~300px lg sidebar) and on mobile.

rtl: The row follows the reading direction: in Arabic, departure is on the right and arrival on the left, and the airplane icon is mirrored to point left.
Times, IATA codes and flight numbers are wrapped in <bdi dir="ltr"> so they never reorder.
rules: Times: heading-1 (24px, A · unverified) with tabular numerals. IATA codes: body-md 700. City: body-sm --color-text-subtle. Path line: 1px --color-border-default with --space-2 dots marking stops. Duration: caption.
Origin / path / destination column gap --space-6; time → IATA → city stack gap --space-1 (spacing.md, flight result card).
